title: bradleia rubra
intro: Bradleia rubra, commonly known as Red Mahina or Red Bradleia, is a flowering plant species native to Hawaii. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Bradleia rubra include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
